children: Here's a list of key deals reported across sectors this week:
Visa Inc.
is said to be in advanced discussions to acquire stablecoin infrastructure and custody company Fireblocks for about $2.5 billion.
Qiagen
on Thursday said it has agreed on an all-cash public takeover from private equity firm EQT valuing the European molecular testing company at about €10.8 billion.
London Stock Exchange Group
to acquire credit intelligence provider Octus from Permira for $3.535B in cash.
Medical distributor Cencora
on Wednesday announced an agreement to acquire American Oncology Network, valuing the cancer care provider at $2.4B, including debt.
CBRE Group

Onnec Group Ltd., a provider of data center infrastructure services to companies in Europe and Asia Pacific, in a move that will enhance CBRE's ability to support clients' data center needs globally, the company said Tuesday.
Salesforce
agreed to buy Braze
, an AI-powered marketing platform, for $5.66B in enterprise value. Braze jumped 51%, while Salesforce fell 1.4%.
Tradeweb Markets
stock jumped 3.7% in Monday after-hours trading after the company announced an
Holdings, a financial technology company, for $1.97B.
DXC Technology
is in advanced discussions to sell its insurance software and services unit to private investment firm Eldridge Industries for about $2.4 billion.
Merck KGaA (MKGAY)
has agreed to acquire Silence Therapeutics
in an all-cash deal with an enterprise value of $1.1B and an equity value of ~$1.3B.
Silgan Holdings
jumped 5.8% pre-market Monday after the packaging solutions company and funds affiliated with American Industrial Partners announced a deal to
Trivium Packaging in an all-cash deal that values Trivium at ~$3.4B enterprise value.
